usage.result_excerpt:
I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It compiles with `wj build` and gives the expected output on both examples when run with `wj run --compiled`.

I also ran one extra case, `-7 2 /`, and it printed `-3`, so division truncates toward zero as required. I didn't test other edge cases, such as a lone `-` token, a line of only spaces, or very large values.
